     2	
     3	## Plan Context
     4	
     5	Complete the namespace migration across the entire GUI stack so that no component uses the legacy bare-slug form without the repository namespace prefix, bringing the frontend and orchestrator queue into alignment for multi-root workspace support.
     6	
     7	## Description
     8	
     9	Add deprecation comments to the non-namespaced route blocks in `server.ts`, marking them as deprecated and scheduled for removal in the next major version.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `mcp-server/gui/server.ts` — non-namespaced route blocks (the `/:slug` variants)
    14

    16	
    17	- Every non-namespaced route block has a `@deprecated` comment indicating it will be removed in the next major version
    18	- Comments specify that the namespaced `/:repo/:slug` variant should be used instead

    36	1. All non-namespaced route blocks in `server.ts` have deprecation comments
    37	2. Comments specify the replacement namespaced route and planned removal version
    38	3. No functional change to route behavior — routes continue to work during the deprecation period

    41

    43

    45
